<script lang="ts">
import { variants } from "../utils";

/** IconTab: the classes of each value (shadcn/cva style). */
export const iconTabVariants = variants({
  base:
    "inline-flex size-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center text-muted-foreground inset-ring " +
    "inset-ring-transparent [&>svg]:size-4 rounded",
  variants: {
    state: {
      default: "",
      active: "bg-card text-foreground inset-ring-border",
    },
  },
  defaultVariants: { state: "default" },
});

export type IconTabProps = {
  active?: boolean;
  label: string;
  class?: string;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import ButtonPlain from "../primitives/button-plain/button-plain.vue";
import { cn } from "../utils";

const { active = false, label, class: className } = defineProps<IconTabProps>();
const emit = defineEmits<{ click: [] }>();
defineSlots<{ default?(): unknown }>();
</script>

<template>
  <ButtonPlain
    type="button"
    role="tab"
    :aria-label="label"
    :class="cn(iconTabVariants({ state: (active ? 'active' : 'default') }), className)"
    :aria-selected="active"
    :tabindex="(active ? 0 : -1)"
    data-slot="icon-tab"
    :data-state="(active ? 'active' : 'default')"
    @click="() => emit('click')"
  >
    <slot />
  </ButtonPlain>
</template>
